note: Curated skills — reusable agent procedures. No public skills catalog exists yet (unlike MCP with modelcontextprotocol.io or A2A with the awslabs samples), so this list is AVA-hand-curated. Entries can be published into the AVA registry as `SKILL` records via the Registry → Skills page once the backend wrappers land.

skills.name: 1-to-5 Scoring Rubric
skills.description: General-purpose 1-to-5 evaluation rubric for LLM-as-judge scoring. Grades response quality against a reference, with explicit anchor points (5 = perfect, 3 = acceptable with issues, 1 = wrong or harmful). Used across Prompt Optimization, Langfuse evals, and Approval-gated agent responses.

skills.name: Structured Field Extraction
skills.description: Given unstructured text and a JSON schema, extract fields conforming to the schema. Enforces field types, marks missing values as null, and refuses to hallucinate. Works with any Bedrock/Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible model that supports JSON mode or tool-calling.

skills.name: KYC Triage Decision
skills.description: Multi-step KYC (Know Your Customer) triage — screens against sanctions/PEP lists, cites the exact regulation on ESCALATE decisions, produces a CLEAR/ESCALATE verdict with rationale. Modeled on the FCA/OFSI/HM Treasury workflow. Skill embodies the procedure; underlying data sources come from MCP servers registered separately.

skills.name: Plain-English Product Disclosure
skills.description: Draft a two-sentence retail product risk disclosure ending in 'Capital at risk.'. Enforces sentence count, forbids jargon, always closes with the mandated phrase. Includes an evaluator that scores against a reference disclosure.

skills.name: Refusal Clause Template
skills.description: Standard refusal clause an agent splices into its system prompt to establish what it will and won't do. Categories: financial advice, medical advice, legal advice, sensitive personal data. Each category has a canonical refusal phrasing so responses are consistent across agents in the fleet.

skills.name: Plan → Execute → Observe
skills.description: Classic ReAct-style planning skill. Agent decomposes a goal into ordered sub-tasks, executes each (calling tools as needed), observes results, and updates the plan if reality diverged from expectations. Produces an execution trace suitable for audit and cost accounting.
